title: Mars
body:
I love the app it’s useful and very easy to use and really helped me to build & track my habits. However if I could have the option to put a negative habit like no sugar ( I’m aiming for 0 per day) but the app doesn’t read 0! Also another example is no coffee!

Also if I can set a control limit or not to exceed feature for example I want not to exceed more than 4 cups of tea per day.
author: Mars 🇴🇲

title: Great app!
body:
The app is easy to use, the user-interface looks great and using the app feels smooth. Adding habits and keeping track of your daily progress is easy and it also shows you your data over the last month which is both interesting and lets you know exactly what you need to improve upon,  it's also motivating just to be able to see your progress. 

Would very much recommend it to anyone on their path to self improvement!
